title: Add private beta artifact verification gate
summary: Add a repeatable verification gate for signed NSIS private-beta artifacts after CI builds updater assets.
reason: The release workflow needs an explicit post-build gate that proves the installer, updater signature, channel JSON, checksums, and Authenticode signature agree before upload or publication.
behavior_before: The workflow generated updater channel JSON and checksums, then uploaded assets, but there was no standalone artifact verification command to validate the final bundle shape.
behavior_after: The workflow and operators can run an artifact verifier that checks NSIS-only output, updater signature linkage, channel JSON URL/signature/version shape, SHA-256 checksum agreement, and Authenticode signature validity.
manual_validation: git diff --check targeted private beta artifact verifier files - passed
pytest release artifact/preflight/productization focused suite - passed (8 passed)
pytest with test_tauri_shell_scaffold.py - failed due unrelated contract drift: POST /api/startup/reconcile-dry-run missing from Tauri required routes
refresh_summaries targeted private beta artifact verifier paths - passed
rollback_plan: Remove the artifact verifier script, tests, workflow/docs references, generated summaries, and this change packet.
notes: This is release verification tooling only. It must not alter installer payloads, updater publishing, media policy, source/scratch/output movement, or backend mutation authority.
